text:
Kevin: Hi all  I submitted my resignation today. Last day will be 2026-07-02. Remote in US, prefer prepaid label for laptop.

Tara: Tara (People Ops)  thanks for the heads up. We'll handle the exit interview and benefits packet. Payroll  can you confirm final pay date and PTO payout?

Payroll: Payroll here  final run 2026-07-06. PTO payout included if termination code TERM_RESIGN submitted by 7/04. Any outstanding expense reports must be in by 7/03.

IT-Ops: IT-Ops  please confirm kevin@redwood.com and any repo ownership. We'll deprovision 2026-07-03 09:00 PT (Okta->GitHub->GCP->Slack).

Kevin: Email kevin@redwood.com. I own one private repo (ml-feature-flag) and a service account export-sa@project. I'll add a repo admin before 6/30 and create a short handoff doc.

Security: Note  rotate service account keys and CI secrets referencing kevin. We'll run rotations after deprovision.

Tara: COBRA/benefits: coverage runs through 07/31/2026 (end of month). COBRA packet will be emailed 2026-07-03 with 60-day election window. Equity: Legal to confirm exercise window.

Legal: Quick confirm  standard grants have 90-day post-termination exercise for voluntary resignations. We'll send the equity FAQ and offer a 1:1 if needed.

Kevin: Thanks  could you confirm if any RSUs vest on 2026-07-15 (I think a tranche is scheduled)?

Payroll: We'll check vesting schedule and respond by EOD. If vest date is after termination, standard plan rules apply (no vest unless specified).

Tara: Scheduling exit interview  options 7/06 10am PT or 7/07 3pm PT. Kevin?

Kevin: 7/06 10am PT works. Please send label for laptop to my home address.

IT-Ops: Ticket OFF-6123 created. Command: `offboard --user kevin@redwood.com --when 2026-07-03T09:00Z --collect-assets --transfer-owner tara@redwood.com`. Adding Tara and Payroll as approvers.

Tara: We'll retain a personal contact email for 12 months for eq/payroll admin only. Any other asks?

Kevin: Please ensure repo admin added before 6/30 so CI isn't affected. Appreciate the fast coordination.

IT-Ops: Will confirm repo handover and service account transfers by 6/30.

Payroll: Confirmed will follow up on vesting and PTO calculation by EOD.

Tara: Thanks team  exit interview booked and benefits packet scheduled. Kevin  we'll send the equipment label tomorrow.

Kevin: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
